P: Period: the time for one orbit
a: Average separation of the two stars
a_1: Star 1's distance from the center of mass
a_2: Star 2's distance from the center of mass
lambda: Wavelength of a spectral line as seen
lambda_1: Wavelength of star 1's line as seen
lambda_2: Wavelength of star 2's line as seen
q: Mass ratio M₂/M₁, equal to a₁/a₂
v: A star's speed along our line of sight
v_1: Star 1's velocity along our line of sight, + away
v_2: Star 2's velocity along our line of sight, + away
